provenance.sourceMaterial: All prose, people, titles and reference records are synthetic.
provenance.independence: Authored without reading src/import*.mjs, the current importer implementation, or any private corpus during this task.
provenance.limitation: Expected outcomes are scholarly interpretation targets. They do not assert that the current importer promises or implements every challenge feature. Style names are descriptive input families.

contract.offsetUnits: Unicode code points, zero-based, end-exclusive. Sources include accented BMP characters and an en dash, with no supplementary-plane characters, so code-point and JavaScript UTF-16 offsets agree.
contract.boundaryMeaning: bodyBoundary selects importable prose. referenceBoundary selects the separately supplied bibliography. Text before and after the body must not generate body citations.
contract.expectedCitations: One item per whole citation span. raw is the exact source substring. recordIds follows source cluster order and contains null for unresolved or ambiguous items.
contract.candidateRecordIds: Optional array parallel to recordIds, with one candidate set per citation item. Empty sets denote missing references. Multi-item sets must remain ambiguous. Candidate order is immaterial.
contract.expectedNonCitations: Exact negative-example strings within the body. These are explanatory expectations, and are not separate citation spans.

evaluationTier.baseline: A target for ordinary author–year or explicit-number imports, safe ambiguity handling and boundary isolation. Actual supported scope must be declared by the runner.
evaluationTier.challenge: Additional notation or metadata variation. Report failures separately from baseline results and identify unsupported syntax honestly.

recordExtensions.referenceNumber: Explicit bibliography number for numeric inputs.
recordExtensions.originalIssued: Original publication date for a reprint. issued is the consulted edition date.
recordExtensions.yearSuffix: Explicit suffix from the supplied reference text, such as 2020a.
